title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Three in Gaza City's Al-Rimal Neighborhood
detail: An Israeli combat drone struck a group of Palestinians near the Palmira slaughterhouse at the junction of Ahmed Abdel Aziz Street and Abdel Qader al-Husseini Street in Gaza City's Al-Rimal neighborhood, killing three and wounding several others, one critically. A separate Israeli drone strike killed additional Palestinians elsewhere in Gaza City and Khan Younis the same day. The strikes were the latest in a pattern of daily ceasefire violations that Gaza's Interior Ministry and UN monitors say has continued largely unabated since the October 2025 truce.

media.caption: Israeli drone strike on Gaza City's Al-Rimal neighborhood kills three — July 29, 2026
